original_proposal.description: The source conventional sodium tetraborate decahydrate formula Na2B4O7·10H2O and structural borax formula Na2[B4O5(OH)4]·8H2O denote the same bulk material. Gainsford etal2008 DOI10.1107/S1600536808010441 explicitly identifies sodium tetraborate decahydrate as the latter structural formula, with Mr381.38. Official CHEBI38888 has that structural formula and381.371 mass; its octahydrate label counts the eight molecular waters after hydroxylation and does not mean Na2B4O7·8H2O. Official supplier CAS1303-96-4/Na2B4O7·10H2O/MW381.37 independently corroborates supplied form. CHEBI131366 and86222 instead contain two excess waters and remain upstream defects. This identity proposal covers explicitly weighed decahydrate reagent contexts; DSMZ7700.1%w/v stock remains a distinct preparation, so no global mediadive.ingredient:196 exact redirect is approved.
